Thailand itineraries

Three ready routes. Use 7 days for Bangkok plus one more place. Use 14 days for north and south. Use 10 days if the islands are the point.

7 daysBangkok plus Chiang Mai or one coast
14 daysBangkok, north, and one south coast
10 days southAndaman in winter, Gulf in summer

Each itinerary names the transport and the booking links. Drop a night before you add a second island group.

Keep going

First weekBest 14 daysSouth islands 10 days

Common questions

Can you see Phuket and Samui in one trip?
Not in a first week. In 14 days you still pick one coast unless you enjoy airport days. The 10-day south plan stays on one sea.
